question:
A patient with acute leukaemia has a very low platelet count. The nurse should:

तीव्र ल्यूकीमिया वाले रोगी में प्लेटलेट की संख्या बहुत कम है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Use gentle handling and watch for bleeding
कोमलता से देखभाल करें और रक्तस्राव की निगरानी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A low platelet count means careful handling and watching for bleeding

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Use firm venepuncture with large needles
बड़ी सुइयों से कसकर सिरा लगाएँ: Large needles increase bleeding risk

C — Give a high dose of aspirin
अधिक मात्रा में एस्पिरिन दें: Aspirin increases bleeding

D — Ignore gum bleeding
मसूड़ों से खून आने को अनदेखा करें: Gum bleeding is a warning sign

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Soft toothbrushes and avoiding injections help prevent bleeding
option_1:
Use gentle handling and watch for bleeding
कोमलता से देखभाल करें और रक्तस्राव की निगरानी करें
option_2:
Use firm venepuncture with large needles
बड़ी सुइयों से कसकर सिरा लगाएँ
option_3:
Give a high dose of aspirin
अधिक मात्रा में एस्पिरिन दें
option_4:
Ignore gum bleeding
मसूड़ों से खून आने को अनदेखा करें

question:
A patient with COPD has worsening breathlessness with thick sputum. The nurse should:

सीओपीडी वाले रोगी को गाढ़े बलगम के साथ साँस फूलना बढ़ रहा है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Give controlled oxygen, encourage fluids and nebulised treatment as ordered
नियंत्रित ऑक्सीजन दें, तरल के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें और आदेश अनुसार नेबुलाइज़्ड उपचार दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Controlled oxygen, fluids and ordered nebulised treatment ease the exacerbation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Restrict all fluids
सारे तरल रोकें: Fluids thin the sputum

B — Give uncontrolled high-flow oxygen
अनियंत्रित उच्च प्रवाह ऑक्सीजन दें: High-flow oxygen can retain carbon dioxide in COPD

D — Give a sedative to calm the patient
रोगी को शांत करने के लिए शामक दें: Sedatives depress breathing

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch the level of consciousness and blood gases during oxygen therapy
option_2:
Give uncontrolled high-flow oxygen
अनियंत्रित उच्च प्रवाह ऑक्सीजन दें
option_3:
Give controlled oxygen, encourage fluids and nebulised treatment as ordered
नियंत्रित ऑक्सीजन दें, तरल के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें और आदेश अनुसार नेबुलाइज़्ड उपचार दें
option_4:
Give a sedative to calm the patient
रोगी को शांत करने के लिए शामक दें

question:
A patient with a kidney stone passing in the urine should be advised to:

मूत्र में गुर्दे की पथरी निकलने वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Drink plenty of fluids and strain the urine
भरपूर तरल पिएँ और मूत्र को छानें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Fluids help flush the stone, and straining catches it for analysis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Restrict all fluids
सारे तरल रोकें: Fluid restriction makes the urine concentrated

B — Take extra salt
अतिरिक्त नमक लें: Extra salt is not advised

C — Avoid all activity
सारी गतिविधि से बचें: Activity is not restricted for a small stone

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Analysing the stone guides diet advice to prevent recurrence
option_4:
Drink plenty of fluids and strain the urine
भरपूर तरल पिएँ और मूत्र को छानें

question:
A patient with epilepsy should be taught to:

मिर्गी वाले रोगी को क्या सिखाया जाना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Take medicines regularly and avoid missed doses
नियमित रूप से दवा लें और खुराक न छोड़ें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular medicines prevent seizures; doses must not be missed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stay awake for long hours
लंबे समय तक जागते रहें: Sleep loss can trigger seizures

C — Swim alone regularly
अकेले नियमित तैरें: Swimming alone is unsafe

D — Stop medicines once seizure-free
दौरे बंद होने पर दवा बंद कर दें: Stopping suddenly can trigger seizures

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise a regular sleep schedule and avoiding known triggers such as alcohol
option_1:
Stay awake for long hours
लंबे समय तक जागते रहें
option_2:
Take medicines regularly and avoid missed doses
नियमित रूप से दवा लें और खुराक न छोड़ें
option_4:
Stop medicines once seizure-free
दौरे बंद होने पर दवा बंद कर दें

question:
The main way to prevent hepatitis B in health workers is:

स्वास्थ्य कर्मियों में हेपेटाइटिस B रोकने का मुख्य तरीका क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Vaccination and safe handling of sharps
टीकाकरण और नुकीली वस्तुओं का सुरक्षित उपयोग

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Hepatitis B is prevented by vaccination and safe sharp handling

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Sharing razors
रेज़र साझा करना: Sharing razors spreads the virus

C — Avoiding hand hygiene
हाथ स्वच्छता से बचना: Hand hygiene is part of safe practice

D — Eating a special diet
विशेष आहार लेना: Diet does not prevent it

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Follow post-exposure rules promptly after any needle-stick injury
option_2:
Vaccination and safe handling of sharps
टीकाकरण और नुकीली वस्तुओं का सुरक्षित उपयोग

question:
An older patient with a fractured neck of the femur must be handled:

कूल्हे की गर्दन के फ्रैक्चर वाले वृद्ध रोगी को कैसे संभालना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Without twisting the leg and with limited movement as ordered
पैर को मोड़े बिना और आदेश अनुसार सीमित गति के साथ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Avoiding twisting and limiting movement protect the fracture

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — With firm leg rotation exercises at once
तुरंत ज़ोरदार पैर घुमाने के अभ्यास के साथ: Rotation worsens the fracture

C — By standing the patient up quickly
रोगी को शीघ्र खड़ा करके: Early standing is unsafe before fixation

D — By ignoring the pain
दर्द को अनदेखा करके: Pain must be assessed and treated

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for fat embolism and clots after a long bone fracture
option_1:
Without twisting the leg and with limited movement as ordered
पैर को मोड़े बिना और आदेश अनुसार सीमित गति के साथ
option_2:
With firm leg rotation exercises at once
तुरंत ज़ोरदार पैर घुमाने के अभ्यास के साथ
option_3:
By standing the patient up quickly
रोगी को शीघ्र खड़ा करके
option_4:
By ignoring the pain
दर्द को अनदेखा करके

question:
Six days after abdominal surgery, a patient feels a "give way" with discharge from the wound. The nurse should:

पेट की सर्जरी के छह दिन बाद रोगी को घाव से निकलन के साथ \"फटने\" का अनुभव होता है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Cover the wound with a sterile dressing and report at once
घाव को बंध्य पट्टी से ढकें और तुरंत सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Covering the wound with a sterile dressing and reporting at once is correct in wound dehiscence

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore the discharge
स्राव को अनदेखा करें: Discharge with a give-way feeling is serious

B — Push the tissue back inside
ऊतक को वापस अंदर धकेलें: Pushing tissue back risks infection

C — Ask the patient to cough hard
रोगी को ज़ोर से खाँसने को कहें: Coughing increases the strain

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Place the patient in a low Fowler position with knees bent to reduce tension
option_2:
Push the tissue back inside
ऊतक को वापस अंदर धकेलें
option_3:
Ask the patient to cough hard
रोगी को ज़ोर से खाँसने को कहें
option_4:
Cover the wound with a sterile dressing and report at once
घाव को बंध्य पट्टी से ढकें और तुरंत सूचना दें

question:
A patient with active pulmonary tuberculosis is admitted. The nurse should:

सक्रिय फुफ्फुसीय तपेदिक वाला रोगी भर्ती होता है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Use the advised airborne precautions and give drugs as ordered
सलाहित वायुजनित सावधानियाँ अपनाएँ और आदेश अनुसार दवा दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Airborne precautions and ordered drugs are essential in active pulmonary tuberculosis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Keep the patient in an open general ward
रोगी को खुले सामान्य वार्ड में रखें: A general ward exposes others to infection

C — Share the patient's mask
रोगी का मास्क साझा करें: Sharing a mask spreads infection

D — Stop drugs once the cough reduces
खाँसी कम होते ही दवा बंद करें: Stopping early causes resistance

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Ensure good ventilation and cover the mouth while coughing
option_1:
Keep the patient in an open general ward
रोगी को खुले सामान्य वार्ड में रखें
option_2:
Use the advised airborne precautions and give drugs as ordered
सलाहित वायुजनित सावधानियाँ अपनाएँ और आदेश अनुसार दवा दें
option_3:
Share the patient's mask
रोगी का मास्क साझा करें
option_4:
Stop drugs once the cough reduces
खाँसी कम होते ही दवा बंद करें

question:
A patient on chemotherapy has painful mouth ulcers. The nurse should advise:

कीमोथेरेपी पर रोगी के मुँह में दर्दभरे छाले हैं। नर्स को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Frequent gentle mouth rinses and soft, bland food
बार-बार कोमल मुँह के कुल्ले और नरम, हल्का भोजन

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Gentle rinses and soft, bland food ease pain and protect the mouth

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hot spicy food to stimulate appetite
भूख बढ़ाने के लिए गर्म मसालेदार भोजन: Hot spicy food irritates the ulcers

C — Avoid all fluids
सारे तरल से बचें: Fluids are needed and soothing

D — A hard toothbrush for cleaning
सफ़ाई के लिए कठोर टूथब्रश: A hard brush injures the gums

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Inspect the mouth daily and use the ordered rinse or pain relief
option_1:
Hot spicy food to stimulate appetite
भूख बढ़ाने के लिए गर्म मसालेदार भोजन
option_2:
Frequent gentle mouth rinses and soft, bland food
बार-बार कोमल मुँह के कुल्ले और नरम, हल्का भोजन
option_4:
A hard toothbrush for cleaning
सफ़ाई के लिए कठोर टूथब्रश

question:
A patient with a suspected spinal injury must be moved. The nurse should:

रीढ़ की चोट के संदेह वाले रोगी को हिलाना है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Use the log-roll method keeping the spine aligned
रीढ़ को सीधा रखते हुए लॉग-रोल विधि अपनाएँ

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The log-roll keeps the spine aligned and prevents further damage

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Let the patient sit up at once
रोगी को तुरंत बैठा दें: Sitting up is unsafe before assessment

C — Pull the patient by the arms
रोगी को बाँहों से खींचें: Pulling by the arms misaligns the spine

D — Twist the body to one side
शरीर को एक तरफ़ मोड़ें: Twisting can injure the spinal cord

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use enough helpers and a rigid board when moving such a patient
option_1:
Use the log-roll method keeping the spine aligned
रीढ़ को सीधा रखते हुए लॉग-रोल विधि अपनाएँ
option_2:
Let the patient sit up at once
रोगी को तुरंत बैठा दें
option_3:
Pull the patient by the arms
रोगी को बाँहों से खींचें
option_4:
Twist the body to one side
शरीर को एक तरफ़ मोड़ें

question:
After a partial gastrectomy, the nurse should advise the patient to:

आंशिक गैस्ट्रेक्टॉमी के बाद नर्स को रोगी को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Eat small frequent meals and sit up after eating
थोड़ा-थोड़ा, बार-बार खाएँ और खाने के बाद बैठे रहें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Small frequent meals and sitting up reduce discomfort after gastrectomy

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Lie down right after eating
खाने के तुरंत बाद लेटें: Lying down after eating worsens symptoms

C — Drink large amounts with meals
भोजन के साथ अधिक तरल पिएँ: Large fluids with meals cause fullness and dumping

D — Eat one large meal a day
दिन में एक भारी भोजन करें: A large meal overfills the small stomach

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for dizziness and sweating after meals, which suggest dumping syndrome
option_1:
Eat small frequent meals and sit up after eating
थोड़ा-थोड़ा, बार-बार खाएँ और खाने के बाद बैठे रहें
option_2:
Lie down right after eating
खाने के तुरंत बाद लेटें
option_3:
Drink large amounts with meals
भोजन के साथ अधिक तरल पिएँ
option_4:
Eat one large meal a day
दिन में एक भारी भोजन करें

question:
A sign of dehydration in an adult is:

वयस्क में निर्जलीकरण का एक संकेत क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Dry mouth, poor skin turgor and concentrated urine
मुँह सूखा, त्वचा की लोच कम और गाढ़ा मूत्र

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A dry mouth, poor skin turgor and concentrated urine indicate dehydration

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Very clear, dilute urine
बहुत साफ़, पतला मूत्र: Clear dilute urine suggests good hydration

B — Slow pulse
धीमी नाड़ी: The pulse is usually fast in dehydration

C — Puffy face
चेहरे पर सूजन: A puffy face suggests fluid overload

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Track intake and output and daily weight to guide rehydration
option_1:
Very clear, dilute urine
बहुत साफ़, पतला मूत्र
option_4:
Dry mouth, poor skin turgor and concentrated urine
मुँह सूखा, त्वचा की लोच कम और गाढ़ा मूत्र

question:
A patient with vertigo should be advised to:

चक्कर (वर्टिगो) वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Move slowly and hold support while walking
धीरे-धीरे चलें और चलते समय सहारा पकड़ें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Slow movement with support reduces the risk of falls from vertigo

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Run quickly to avoid falls
गिरने से बचने के लिए तेज़ दौड़ें: Running increases the risk of falls

B — Climb ladders alone
अकेले सीढ़ी चढ़ें: Ladders are unsafe with dizziness

D — Ignore the dizziness
चक्कर को अनदेखा करें: Dizziness needs care, not ignoring

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Remove obstacles at home and rise slowly from bed
option_1:
Run quickly to avoid falls
गिरने से बचने के लिए तेज़ दौड़ें
option_3:
Move slowly and hold support while walking
धीरे-धीरे चलें और चलते समय सहारा पकड़ें

question:
A patient with varicose veins should be advised to:

वैरिकोज़ वेन वाले रोगी को क्या सलाह दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Avoid long standing and elevate the legs when resting
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहने से बचें और आराम के समय पैर ऊँचे रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Avoiding long standing and elevating the legs improve venous return

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stand for very long hours
बहुत लंबे समय तक खड़े रहें: Prolonged standing worsens varicose veins

C — Wear very tight bands without advice
बिना सलाह बहुत कसे बैंड पहनें: Tight bands without advice can harm circulation

D — Keep the legs hanging down
पैरों को लटकाकर रखें: A dependent position increases swelling

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Ordered compression stockings and walking help the circulation
option_1:
Stand for very long hours
बहुत लंबे समय तक खड़े रहें
option_2:
Avoid long standing and elevate the legs when resting
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहने से बचें और आराम के समय पैर ऊँचे रखें
option_3:
Wear very tight bands without advice
बिना सलाह बहुत कसे बैंड पहनें
option_4:
Keep the legs hanging down
पैरों को लटकाकर रखें

question:
The correct hand washing technique includes:

सही हाथ धोने की तकनीक में क्या शामिल है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Rubbing all surfaces with soap for at least the advised time
सलाहित समय तक साबुन से सभी सतहों को रगड़ना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Soap and friction on all surfaces for the advised time remove organisms

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Washing only the palms
केवल हथेलियाँ धोना: Palms alone miss the fingers and thumbs

C — Using plain water only
केवल सादा पानी उपयोग करना: Water alone does not remove organisms well

D — Drying on a dirty towel
गंदे तौलिये पर सुखाना: A dirty towel recontaminates the hands

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Include the thumbs, fingertips and wrists, then dry with a clean towel
option_1:
Rubbing all surfaces with soap for at least the advised time
सलाहित समय तक साबुन से सभी सतहों को रगड़ना
option_3:
Using plain water only
केवल सादा पानी उपयोग करना
option_4:
Drying on a dirty towel
गंदे तौलिये पर सुखाना

question:
Mouth care for a conscious patient should be given:

सचेत रोगी को मुँह की देखभाल कब दी जानी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. At least twice a day and after meals
दिन में कम से कम दो बार और भोजन के बाद

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Regular mouth care at least twice daily and after meals keeps the mouth clean

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Never
कभी नहीं: Mouth care is essential

B — Only once a month
महीने में केवल एक बार: Once a month is far too little

C — Only when the patient asks
केवल जब रोगी माँगे: It should be routine, not only on request

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check for sores and keep the lips moist
option_2:
Only once a month
महीने में केवल एक बार
option_3:
Only when the patient asks
केवल जब रोगी माँगे
option_4:
At least twice a day and after meals
दिन में कम से कम दो बार और भोजन के बाद

question:
Rotating injection sites is important mainly to:

इंजेक्शन के स्थान बदलते रहना मुख्य रूप से किसलिए महत्वपूर्ण है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Prevent tissue damage and poor absorption
ऊतक क्षति और खराब अवशोषण से बचने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Rotating sites prevents tissue damage and poor absorption

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Increase the pain
दर्द बढ़ाने के लिए: It reduces, not increases, pain

C — Delay the injection
इंजेक्शन में देरी करने के लिए: It does not delay the injection

D — Reduce the drug effect
दवा का असर घटाने के लिए: It supports, not reduces, the drug effect

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep a record of the sites used, especially for insulin injections
option_1:
Prevent tissue damage and poor absorption
ऊतक क्षति और खराब अवशोषण से बचने के लिए
option_3:
Delay the injection
इंजेक्शन में देरी करने के लिए
option_4:
Reduce the drug effect
दवा का असर घटाने के लिए

question:
A simple face mask typically delivers an oxygen concentration of about:

साधारण फेस मास्क सामान्यतः लगभग कितनी ऑक्सीजन सांद्रता देता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 40 to 60 percent
40 से 60 प्रतिशत

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A simple face mask delivers about 40 to 60 percent oxygen

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 10 percent
10 प्रतिशत: 10 percent is below room air

B — 24 percent
24 प्रतिशत: 24 percent is like a low-flow nasal cannula

D — 100 percent
100 प्रतिशत: 100 percent needs a non-rebreather mask or intubation

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Choose the device according to the oxygen concentration needed

question:
While assisting with urinary catheter insertion, the nurse should:

मूत्र कैथेटर डालने में सहायता करते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Maintain aseptic technique and provide privacy
बंध्य तकनीक बनाए रखें और गोपनीयता दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Aseptic technique and privacy are essential during catheter insertion

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Leave the patient uncovered
रोगी को बिना ढके छोड़ें: The patient should always be covered

C — Use tap water as lubricant
स्नेहक के रूप में नल का पानी उपयोग करें: Water is not a sterile lubricant

D — Touch the catheter tip with bare hands
कैथेटर की नोक को नंगे हाथों से छुएँ: Touching the tip contaminates the catheter

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Secure the catheter and keep the drainage bag below the bladder
option_1:
Maintain aseptic technique and provide privacy
बंध्य तकनीक बनाए रखें और गोपनीयता दें
option_2:
Leave the patient uncovered
रोगी को बिना ढके छोड़ें
option_3:
Use tap water as lubricant
स्नेहक के रूप में नल का पानी उपयोग करें
option_4:
Touch the catheter tip with bare hands
कैथेटर की नोक को नंगे हाथों से छुएँ

question:
While applying a cold compress for fever, the nurse should:

बुखार के लिए ठंडी सिकाई लगाते समय नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Check the skin often and stop if the patient shivers
त्वचा को बार-बार जाँचें और काँपने पर रोक दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Checking the skin and stopping when the patient shivers prevents harm

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Leave it on for hours without checking
बिना जाँच के घंटों छोड़ दें: Prolonged application can injure the skin

B — Apply it over the eyes
इसे आँखों पर लगाएँ: Cold over the eyes is unsafe

D — Use ice-cold water over the whole body
पूरे शरीर पर बर्फ़ जैसा ठंडा पानी डालें: Whole-body ice water causes shivering and raises heat production

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Shivering raises the temperature, so warm the patient gently instead
option_1:
Leave it on for hours without checking
बिना जाँच के घंटों छोड़ दें
option_2:
Apply it over the eyes
इसे आँखों पर लगाएँ
option_3:
Check the skin often and stop if the patient shivers
त्वचा को बार-बार जाँचें और काँपने पर रोक दें
option_4:
Use ice-cold water over the whole body
पूरे शरीर पर बर्फ़ जैसा ठंडा पानी डालें

question:
Before helping a patient to walk for the first time after surgery, the nurse should:

सर्जरी के बाद पहली बार रोगी को चलाने से पहले नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Check for dizziness and use a support with assistance
चक्कर की जाँच करें और सहायता के साथ सहारा उपयोग करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Checking for dizziness and using support with assistance prevents falls

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ask the patient to walk alone quickly
रोगी को अकेले तेज़ चलने को कहें: Walking alone quickly risks a fall

C — Ignore the blood pressure
रक्तचाप को अनदेखा करें: Low blood pressure can cause fainting

D — Let the patient walk on a wet floor
रोगी को गीले फर्श पर चलने दें: A wet floor is a slipping hazard

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Assist the patient gradually and increase activity as tolerated
option_1:
Ask the patient to walk alone quickly
रोगी को अकेले तेज़ चलने को कहें
option_2:
Check for dizziness and use a support with assistance
चक्कर की जाँच करें और सहायता के साथ सहारा उपयोग करें
option_3:
Ignore the blood pressure
रक्तचाप को अनदेखा करें
option_4:
Let the patient walk on a wet floor
रोगी को गीले फर्श पर चलने दें

question:
Vital signs should be recorded:

जीवन-चिह्न कब दर्ज किए जाने चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Immediately at the bedside in the correct chart
तुरंत बिस्तर पर ही सही चार्ट में

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vital signs are recorded at the bedside right away to keep the record accurate

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only when the doctor asks
केवल जब डॉक्टर पूछे: They are recorded routinely, not on request

B — From memory at the end of the shift
पाली के अंत में स्मृति से: Recording from memory risks errors

C — On a loose paper
एक ढीले कागज़ पर: Loose papers can be lost

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report any abnormal reading at once and repeat it as needed
option_1:
Only when the doctor asks
केवल जब डॉक्टर पूछे
option_2:
From memory at the end of the shift
पाली के अंत में स्मृति से
option_3:
On a loose paper
एक ढीले कागज़ पर
option_4:
Immediately at the bedside in the correct chart
तुरंत बिस्तर पर ही सही चार्ट में

question:
The main purpose of isolation precautions is to:

अलगाव सावधानियों का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Prevent the spread of infection to others
दूसरों में संक्रमण फैलने से रोकना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Isolation precautions stop infection from spreading to others

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Punish the patient
रोगी को दंडित करना: They are not a punishment

B — Avoid giving care
देखभाल देने से बचना: Care is still given, with precautions

D — Increase the cost of care
देखभाल की लागत बढ़ाना: Cost is not the aim

⚠️ Exam Trap: In procedure questions choose the step that protects the patient first - safety before comfort and speed.

💎 PNC Pearl: Explain the reason to the patient so that isolation does not feel like rejection
option_3:
Prevent the spread of infection to others
दूसरों में संक्रमण फैलने से रोकना
option_4:
Increase the cost of care
देखभाल की लागत बढ़ाना

question:
A pregnant woman at 20 weeks has a low haemoglobin level due to iron deficiency. The nurse should advise her to:

20 सप्ताह की गर्भवती महिला में लौह-न्यूनता के कारण हीमोग्लोबिन कम है। नर्स को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Take iron and folic acid tablets with citrus fruit
खट्टे फल के साथ लोह और फोलिक अम्ल की गोलियाँ लें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Iron with vitamin C from citrus fruit improves absorption and corrects anaemia

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Stop all the supplements
सारे पूरक बंद करें: Stopping supplements worsens anaemia

B — Eat only polished rice
केवल पॉलिश किया चावल खाएँ: Polished rice is poor in iron

D — Take iron with strong tea
लोहे की गोली तेज़ चाय के साथ लें: Tea contains tannins that reduce iron absorption

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Start iron and folic acid supplements as per the national anaemia programme guidelines
option_1:
Stop all the supplements
सारे पूरक बंद करें
option_2:
Eat only polished rice
केवल पॉलिश किया चावल खाएँ
option_3:
Take iron and folic acid tablets with citrus fruit
खट्टे फल के साथ लोह और फोलिक अम्ल की गोलियाँ लें
option_4:
Take iron with strong tea
लोहे की गोली तेज़ चाय के साथ लें

question:
During labour the nurse notes meconium-stained fluid with a fall in the fetal heart rate. The nurse should:

प्रसव के दौरान नर्स को मलयुक्त तरल और भ्रूण हृदय गति में गिरावट दिखती है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Report at once and prepare for fetal monitoring and delivery
तुरंत सूचना दें और भ्रूण निगरानी तथा प्रसव की तैयारी करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Meconium with a falling fetal heart rate signals fetal distress needing urgent review and delivery

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Give a sedative to the mother
माँ को शामक दें: A sedative does not treat fetal distress

C — Ignore the changes
परिवर्तनों को अनदेखा करें: These are danger signs, not to be ignored

D — Wait for the next contraction round
अगले संकुचन समूह की प्रतीक्षा करें: Delay risks harm to the baby

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Position the mother on her left side and give oxygen while awaiting delivery
option_1:
Report at once and prepare for fetal monitoring and delivery
तुरंत सूचना दें और भ्रूण निगरानी तथा प्रसव की तैयारी करें
option_2:
Give a sedative to the mother
माँ को शामक दें
option_4:
Wait for the next contraction round
अगले संकुचन समूह की प्रतीक्षा करें

question:
On the third day after delivery a woman has high fever, foul-smelling discharge and lower abdominal pain. This most likely suggests:

प्रसव के तीसरे दिन महिला को तेज़ बुखार, दुर्गंधयुक्त स्राव और पेट के निचले हिस्से में दर्द है। यह सबसे अधिक किस ओर संकेत करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Puerperal sepsis
प्रसवोत्तर पूति (सेप्सिस)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Fever with foul-smelling discharge and abdominal pain points to puerperal sepsis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Normal afterpains
सामान्य प्रसवोत्तर पीड़ा: Afterpains are cramping but not febrile

B — Normal lochia
सामान्य लोकिया: Normal lochia is not foul-smelling

C — Breast engorgement
स्तन भराव: Engorgement causes breast pain, not pelvic infection

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report at once and start ordered antibiotics, as sepsis can spread quickly

question:
A woman with pre-eclampsia on magnesium sulphate suddenly has absent knee reflexes and slow breathing. The nurse should:

प्री-एक्लेम्पसिया वाली और मैग्नीशियम सल्फेट ले रही महिला में अचानक घुटने की प्रतिक्रिया नहीं है और साँस धीमी है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Stop the infusion and report at once
आधान शीघ्र रोकें और तुरंत सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Loss of knee reflexes and slow breathing are early signs of magnesium toxicity, so the drug is stopped and reported

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore the signs
संकेतों को अनदेखा करें: Ignoring it can lead to respiratory arrest

C — Give more magnesium at once
तुरंत अधिक मैग्नीशियम दें: More magnesium deepens the poisoning

D — Increase the infusion rate
आधान की गति बढ़ाएँ: Raising the rate worsens toxicity

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep calcium gluconate ready as the antidote and check reflexes before each dose
option_2:
Stop the infusion and report at once
आधान शीघ्र रोकें और तुरंत सूचना दें
option_3:
Give more magnesium at once
तुरंत अधिक मैग्नीशियम दें
option_4:
Increase the infusion rate
आधान की गति बढ़ाएँ

question:
The APGAR score of a newborn is assessed mainly to:

नवजात का एपगर स्कोर मुख्य रूप से किसलिए आँका जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Judge the immediate condition and the need for help with breathing
तत्काल स्थिति और श्वसन सहायता की आवश्यकता आँकने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The APGAR score quickly grades how well the newborn is breathing and adapting

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Measure the birth weight
जन्म भार मापने के लिए: Birth weight is measured separately

C — Decide the feeding schedule
आहार का समय तय करने के लिए: Feeding is not decided by the APGAR score

D — Test the hearing
सुनने की जाँच के लिए: Hearing is tested later by other methods

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: The score is taken at 1 and 5 minutes after birth and repeated if it stays low
option_1:
Measure the birth weight
जन्म भार मापने के लिए
option_2:
Judge the immediate condition and the need for help with breathing
तत्काल स्थिति और श्वसन सहायता की आवश्यकता आँकने के लिए
option_3:
Decide the feeding schedule
आहार का समय तय करने के लिए
option_4:
Test the hearing
सुनने की जाँच के लिए

question:
Soon after delivery of the baby a woman has heavy vaginal bleeding with a soft, relaxed uterus. The nurse should first:

शिशु के जन्म के तुरंत बाद महिला को तेज़ योनि रक्तस्राव है और गर्भाशय कोमल व शिथिल है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Massage the uterus, give ordered uterotonics and report the bleeding
गर्भाशय की मालिश करें, आदेशित गर्भाशय-संकोचक दें और रक्तस्राव की सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A soft uterus with heavy bleeding means uterine atony, so massage, uterotonics and quick reporting stop the loss of blood

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Wait for the bleeding to stop by itself
रक्तस्राव के स्वयं रुकने की प्रतीक्षा करें: Waiting allows dangerous blood loss

C — Give a hot bath
गर्म स्नान कराएँ: A hot bath does not treat atony

D — Delay reporting
सूचना देने में देरी करें: Delay can lead to shock

⚠️ Exam Trap: In obstetric questions ask who is at immediate risk, mother or fetus - that decides the first action.

💎 PNC Pearl: Postpartum haemorrhage is an emergency; watch the pulse and blood pressure closely
option_1:
Massage the uterus, give ordered uterotonics and report the bleeding
गर्भाशय की मालिश करें, आदेशित गर्भाशय-संकोचक दें और रक्तस्राव की सूचना दें
option_2:
Wait for the bleeding to stop by itself
रक्तस्राव के स्वयं रुकने की प्रतीक्षा करें

question:
For a stable low birth-weight baby, kangaroo mother care mainly helps by:

स्थिर कम जन्म-भार वाले शिशु में कंगारू मातृ देखभाल मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार मदद करती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Giving skin-to-skin warmth and promoting breastfeeding
त्वचा-से-त्वचा गर्माहट देने और स्तनपान को बढ़ावा देने से

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Skin-to-skin contact keeps the baby warm and encourages frequent breastfeeding

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Replacing all feeding
सारे आहार की जगह लेने से: It does not replace feeding; it supports it

C — Avoiding all contact
सारे संपर्क से बचने से: Close contact is the whole idea

D — Cooling the baby
शिशु को ठंडा करने से: The aim is warmth, not cooling

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep the baby upright on the mother's chest, day and night, for stable temperature and bonding
option_1:
Giving skin-to-skin warmth and promoting breastfeeding
त्वचा-से-त्वचा गर्माहट देने और स्तनपान को बढ़ावा देने से
option_2:
Replacing all feeding
सारे आहार की जगह लेने से
option_3:
Avoiding all contact
सारे संपर्क से बचने से
option_4:
Cooling the baby
शिशु को ठंडा करने से

question:
A patient on digoxin has nausea, vomiting and a heart rate of 48 beats per minute. The nurse should:

डिगॉक्सिन ले रहे रोगी को जी मिचलाना, उल्टी और हृदय गति 48 प्रति मिनट है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Hold the digoxin and report at once
डिगॉक्सिन रोकें और तुरंत सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Nausea with a very slow pulse suggests digoxin toxicity, so the drug is held and reported

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Give the next digoxin dose on time
अगली डिगॉक्सिन खुराक समय पर दें: Another dose would deepen the toxicity

C — Increase the next dose
अगली खुराक बढ़ाएँ: Increasing the dose is dangerous

D — Ignore the slow pulse
धीमी नाड़ी को अनदेखा करें: A slow pulse must never be ignored

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Count the pulse for a full minute before each dose, and hold it if it is below the ordered limit
option_1:
Give the next digoxin dose on time
अगली डिगॉक्सिन खुराक समय पर दें
option_2:
Hold the digoxin and report at once
डिगॉक्सिन रोकें और तुरंत सूचना दें
option_4:
Ignore the slow pulse
धीमी नाड़ी को अनदेखा करें

question:
The antidote used for a heparin overdose is:

हेपरिन की अधिक मात्रा के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला प्रतिविष क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Protamine sulphate
प्रोटामिन सल्फेट

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Protamine sulphate neutralises heparin and reverses its effect

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Vitamin K
विटामिन K: Vitamin K reverses warfarin, not heparin

C — Naloxone
नैलोक्सोन: Naloxone reverses opioid overdose

D — Atropine
एट्रोपिन: Atropine reverses organophosphate or vagal effects

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep protamine sulphate available wherever heparin is given

question:
A patient who took insulin is sweating, shaky and confused. The nurse should first:

इंसुलिन ले चुके रोगी को पसीना, कँपकँपी और भ्रम है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Give a fast-acting sugar source
शीघ्र-असर शर्करा स्रोत दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Sweating, shakiness and confusion are signs of low blood sugar, so a fast sugar source is given at once

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Restrict all fluids
सारे तरल रोकें: Fluids are not restricted in hypoglycaemia

B — Give extra insulin
अतिरिक्त इंसुलिन दें: More insulin lowers the sugar further

C — Ignore the symptoms
लक्षणों को अनदेखा करें: Ignoring it can lead to unconsciousness

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: If the patient cannot swallow safely, give glucagon or intravenous glucose as ordered
option_4:
Give a fast-acting sugar source
शीघ्र-असर शर्करा स्रोत दें

question:
A patient on morphine has slow, shallow breathing. The nurse should:

मॉर्फिन ले रहे रोगी की साँस धीमी और उथली है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Withhold the drug, stimulate breathing and report at once
दवा रोकें, श्वसन उत्तेजित करें और तुरंत सूचना दें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Slow, shallow breathing is opioid-induced respiratory depression, so the drug is withheld and reported

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore the breathing pattern
श्वसन के ढंग को अनदेखा करें: Breathing must be watched closely during opioid therapy

B — Give more morphine
अधिक मॉर्फिन दें: More morphine worsens respiratory depression

D — Give a large dose of a sedative
अधिक मात्रा में शामक दें: A sedative deepens the depression

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep naloxone ready as the antidote for opioid overdose
option_1:
Ignore the breathing pattern
श्वसन के ढंग को अनदेखा करें
option_3:
Withhold the drug, stimulate breathing and report at once
दवा रोकें, श्वसन उत्तेजित करें और तुरंत सूचना दें
option_4:
Give a large dose of a sedative
अधिक मात्रा में शामक दें

question:
After a first dose of a penicillin injection a patient develops itching, facial swelling and difficulty in breathing. The nurse should first:

पेनिसिलिन इंजेक्शन की पहली खुराक के बाद रोगी को खुजली, चेहरे में सूजन और साँस लेने में कठिनाई होती है। नर्स को पहले क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Stop the drug and give ordered adrenaline while keeping the airway open
दवा रोकें, आदेशित एड्रेनलीन दें और वायुमार्ग खुला रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Itching, facial swelling and breathlessness signal anaphylaxis, so the drug is stopped, adrenaline is given and the airway is kept open

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Continue the injection
इंजेक्शन जारी रखें: Continuing the drug worsens the reaction

B — Ignore the reaction
प्रतिक्रिया को अनदेखा करें: Anaphylaxis is a life-threatening emergency

D — Give a second dose quickly
जल्दी से दूसरी खुराक दें: A repeat dose can be fatal

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Pearl: Keep the patient under observation after a first parenteral antibiotic dose, as advised
option_3:
Stop the drug and give ordered adrenaline while keeping the airway open
दवा रोकें, आदेशित एड्रेनलीन दें और वायुमार्ग खुला रखें
option_4:
Give a second dose quickly
जल्दी से दूसरी खुराक दें

question:
During a home visit the nurse finds an adult with a cough lasting more than two weeks. As per the national programme the nurse should:

घर-भ्रमण के दौरान नर्स को दो सप्ताह से अधिक समय से खाँसी वाला व्यक्ति मिलता है। राष्ट्रीय कार्यक्रम के अनुसार नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Refer the person for sputum examination for tuberculosis
व्यक्ति को क्षय रोग की थूक जाँच के लिए भेजें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A cough for more than two weeks is a screening symptom for tuberculosis, so sputum examination is needed

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Advise no follow-up
किसी अनुवर्ती सलाह की ज़रूरत नहीं बताएँ: Follow-up is essential in TB care

C — Ignore it as it may be the weather
इसे मौसम का असर मानकर अनदेखा करें: Such a cough is a warning sign, not the weather

D — Give only a cough syrup and close the case
केवल खाँसी की दवा दें और मामला बंद करें: A cough syrup alone delays diagnosis

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Early diagnosis under NTEP prevents the spread of tuberculosis in the community
option_1:
Refer the person for sputum examination for tuberculosis
व्यक्ति को क्षय रोग की थूक जाँच के लिए भेजें
option_2:
Advise no follow-up
किसी अनुवर्ती सलाह की ज़रूरत नहीं बताएँ
option_3:
Ignore it as it may be the weather
इसे मौसम का असर मानकर अनदेखा करें
option_4:
Give only a cough syrup and close the case
केवल खाँसी की दवा दें और मामला बंद करें

question:
Vaccines in the cold chain are stored at:

शीत-शृंखला में टीके किस तापमान पर रखे जाते हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 2 to 8 degrees Celsius
2 से 8 डिग्री सेल्सियस

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Most vaccines stay potent when kept between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — At room temperature
कमरे के तापमान पर: Room temperature spoils the vaccine

C — Below 2 degrees Celsius
2 डिग्री सेल्सियस से नीचे: Too cold storage can also damage the vaccine

D — Frozen at -20 degrees Celsius
-20 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर जमा कर: Freezing damages many vaccines such as DPT and hepatitis B

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Check the vaccine vial monitor before giving any dose
option_2:
2 to 8 degrees Celsius
2 से 8 डिग्री सेल्सियस
option_3:
Below 2 degrees Celsius
2 डिग्री सेल्सियस से नीचे
option_4:
Frozen at -20 degrees Celsius
-20 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर जमा कर

question:
Bleaching powder is added to a well mainly to:

कुएँ में ब्लीचिंग पाउडर मुख्य रूप से किसलिए डाला जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Kill disease-causing germs in the water
पानी में रोगजनक कीटाणु मारने के लिए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Chlorination destroys the germs that cause water-borne disease

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Change the taste of the water
पानी का स्वाद बदलने के लिए: Taste is not the aim

C — Make the water hard
पानी को कठोर बनाने के लिए: Hardness is unrelated

D — Add minerals to the water
पानी में खनिज जोड़ने के लिए: Minerals are not added this way

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use the correct amount of bleaching powder, as excess makes the water unfit to drink
option_1:
Change the taste of the water
पानी का स्वाद बदलने के लिए
option_2:
Kill disease-causing germs in the water
पानी में रोगजनक कीटाणु मारने के लिए
option_3:
Make the water hard
पानी को कठोर बनाने के लिए
option_4:
Add minerals to the water
पानी में खनिज जोड़ने के लिए

question:
The number of new cases of a disease arising in a population during a given period is called:

किसी निश्चित अवधि में जनसंख्या में उत्पन्न रोग के नए मामलों की संख्या कहलाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Incidence
घटना दर (इंसिडेंस)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Incidence counts only the new cases over a period

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Mortality rate
मृत्यु दर: Mortality rate measures deaths

B — Prevalence
व्यापकता (प्रेवलेंस): Prevalence counts all existing cases at a point or period

D — Attack index
आक्रमण सूचकांक: Attack index is used in outbreak studies, not this definition

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Incidence helps judge the spread of a disease and plan control measures

question:
Which temporary family planning method also protects against sexually transmitted infections?

कौन-सी अस्थायी परिवार नियोजन विधि यौन संचारित संक्रमण से भी बचाव करती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Condom
कंडोम

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A condom prevents pregnancy and also blocks sexually transmitted infections

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Copper-T
कॉपर-टी: Copper-T does not protect against infection

B — Oral contraceptive pills
मुँह से ली जाने वाली गर्भनिरोधक गोलियाँ: Pills do not protect against infection

D — Sterilisation
नसबंदी: Sterilisation is a permanent method and gives no infection protection

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Teach correct use and consistent use for both the benefits
option_2:
Oral contraceptive pills
मुँह से ली जाने वाली गर्भनिरोधक गोलियाँ

question:
As per NTEP, the standard duration of treatment for a new drug-susceptible pulmonary tuberculosis patient is:

एनटीईपी के अनुसार नए औषध-संवेदनशील फुफ्फुसीय क्षय रोगी के उपचार की मानक अवधि क्या है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 6 months
6 महीने

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A new drug-susceptible case is treated for six months with the daily regimen under NTEP

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 3 months
3 महीने: Three months is far too short

B — 12 months
12 महीने: Twelve months is not the standard for this group

D — 18 months
18 महीने: Eighteen months is used only for certain resistant or complicated cases

⚠️ Exam Trap: In community health questions ask whether the action is at family, community or facility level.

💎 PNC Pearl: Emphasise completing the full course so that resistance does not develop

question:
While teaching a mother to prepare ORS at home, the nurse should advise her to:

घर पर ओआरएस बनाना सिखाते समय नर्स को माँ को क्या सलाह देनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Dissolve the full packet in the correct measured amount of clean water
पूरा पैकेट सही मापे गए साफ़ पानी में घोलें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The whole packet in the correct amount of clean water gives the right concentration

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Use less water than advised
सलाह से कम पानी उपयोग करें: Less water makes the solution too strong

C — Add extra sugar to make it sweeter
स्वाद बढ़ाने के लिए अतिरिक्त चीनी डालें: Extra sugar can worsen diarrhoea

D — Prepare it and store it for days
बनाकर कई दिनों तक रखें: Stored solution can get contaminated

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give ORS by spoonfuls during diarrhoea and continue breastfeeding
option_1:
Dissolve the full packet in the correct measured amount of clean water
पूरा पैकेट सही मापे गए साफ़ पानी में घोलें
option_2:
Use less water than advised
सलाह से कम पानी उपयोग करें
option_3:
Add extra sugar to make it sweeter
स्वाद बढ़ाने के लिए अतिरिक्त चीनी डालें
option_4:
Prepare it and store it for days
बनाकर कई दिनों तक रखें

question:
A child with oedema, poor growth and a puffy face most likely has:

सूजन, कम वृद्धि और फूले चेहरे वाले बच्चे को सबसे अधिक कौन-सा रोग होने की संभावना है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Kwashiorkor
क्वाशियोरकोर

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Oedema with a puffy face and poor growth is typical of kwashiorkor from protein deficiency

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Marasmus
मैरास्मस: Marasmus shows severe wasting without oedema

B — Rickets
सूखा रोग (रिकेट्स): Rickets affects bones, not the face in this way

D — Obesity
मोटापा: Obesity does not cause oedema with poor growth

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Kwashiorkor needs a gradual, protein-adequate diet, as rapid feeding can be harmful

question:
A newborn with jaundice is on phototherapy. The nurse should:

पीलिया वाले नवजात को प्रकाश-चिकित्सा दी जा रही है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Keep the baby undressed with the eyes protected under the light
शिशु को बिना कपड़ों के रखें और आँखों को सुरक्षित करते हुए प्रकाश में रखें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Maximum skin exposure with eye protection makes phototherapy effective

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Reduce the feeds
आहार कम करें: Feeds are continued to flush out bilirubin

B — Skip feeds during therapy
चिकित्सा के दौरान आहार छोड़ दें: Skipping feeds worsens jaundice

D — Wrap the baby fully
शिशु को पूरी तरह लपेट दें: Wrapping blocks the light and reduces the effect

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch for dehydration and keep the baby well fed during phototherapy
option_2:
Skip feeds during therapy
चिकित्सा के दौरान आहार छोड़ दें
option_3:
Keep the baby undressed with the eyes protected under the light
शिशु को बिना कपड़ों के रखें और आँखों को सुरक्षित करते हुए प्रकाश में रखें
option_4:
Wrap the baby fully
शिशु को पूरी तरह लपेट दें

question:
A toddler has sudden colicky pain with drawing up of the legs and red currant jelly stools. This most likely suggests:

एक छोटे बच्चे को अचानक ऐंठनदार दर्द, पैरों का ऊपर खिंचाव और लाल जेली जैसा मल है। यह सबसे अधिक किस ओर संकेत करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Intussusception
आंत्र-प्रवेश (इंटुससेप्शन)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Colicky pain with red currant jelly stools is classic for intussusception, a surgical emergency

🔍 Key Clues: toddler

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Simple constipation
साधारण कब्ज़: Constipation does not cause jelly stools with such pain

B — Teething
दाँत निकलना: Teething does not cause these signs

C — Ordinary colic only
केवल साधारण पेट-दर्द: Ordinary colic settles and does not show these stools

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Report at once, as delay can lead to bowel obstruction and gangrene

question:
BCG vaccine given to a newborn mainly protects against:

नवजात को दिया जाने वाला बीसीजी टीका मुख्य रूप से किससे बचाव करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Severe forms of childhood tuberculosis
बचपन के क्षय रोग के गंभीर रूप

🧠 Clinical Rationale: BCG protects against severe forms such as miliary and meningeal tuberculosis

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Tetanus
टिटनेस: Tetanus is prevented by the DPT or TT vaccine

B — Only measles
केवल खसरा: Measles is prevented by the measles-rubella vaccine

C — Polio
पोलियो: Polio is prevented by oral or injectable polio vaccine

⚠️ Exam Trap: In paediatric questions look at the age first - the normal values and the expected action change with age.

💎 PNC Pearl: Give BCG at birth on the left upper arm and record the site
option_4:
Severe forms of childhood tuberculosis
बचपन के क्षय रोग के गंभीर रूप

question:
The first heart sound is produced mainly by the closing of the:

पहली हृदय ध्वनि मुख्य रूप से किसके बंद होने से उत्पन्न होती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Mitral and tricuspid valves
माइट्रल और ट्राइकस्पिड वाल्व

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The first sound (S1) is from the closure of the mitral and tricuspid valves at the start of systole

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Pericardium
हृदयावरण: The pericardium is a covering, not a sound source

B — Aortic and pulmonary valves
महाधमनी और फुफ्फुसीय वाल्व: Their closure causes the second heart sound

C — Ventricular wall
निलय की भित्ति: The ventricular wall does not produce the sound

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: A muffled first sound may be noted in a weak or failing heart, so listen carefully
option_2:
Aortic and pulmonary valves
महाधमनी और फुफ्फुसीय वाल्व
option_4:
Mitral and tricuspid valves
माइट्रल और ट्राइकस्पिड वाल्व

question:
The blood cells mainly responsible for clotting of blood are:

रक्त का थक्का बनाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन-सी रक्त कोशिकाएँ उत्तरदायी हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Platelets
प्लेटलेट्स (बिंबाणु)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Platelets clump at the injured site and start the clotting process

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Red blood cells
लाल रक्त कोशिकाएँ: Red cells carry oxygen

B — White blood cells
श्वेत रक्त कोशिकाएँ: White cells fight infection

D — Plasma
प्लाज़्मा: Plasma is the fluid part of blood

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: A low platelet count raises the risk of bleeding, so watch for petechiae and bruises

question:
Exchange of gases in the lungs takes place mainly in the:

फुफ्फुस में गैसों का आदान-प्रदान मुख्य रूप से कहाँ होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Alveoli
वायुकोष (एल्वियोली)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The thin alveolar walls let oxygen and carbon dioxide move in and out of the blood

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Trachea
श्वासनली: The trachea is a passage, not a site of exchange

C — Bronchi
श्वसनी: Bronchi only carry air

D — Pleura
फुफ्फुसावरण: The pleura is a covering

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Fluids or secretions in the alveoli block this exchange and cause breathlessness

question:
The normal pH of arterial blood is about:

धमनी रक्त का सामान्य pH लगभग कितना होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 7.35 to 7.45
7.35 से 7.45

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Arterial blood is normally slightly alkaline at pH 7.35 to 7.45

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 7.8 to 8.0
7.8 से 8.0: This is too alkaline

C — 6.8 to 7.0
6.8 से 7.0: This is far too acidic

D — 5.5 to 6.0
5.5 से 6.0: This is strongly acidic

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: The body tightly controls pH, and values outside 7.35 to 7.45 need urgent attention

question:
The part of the brain that mainly controls balance and coordination of movement is the:

मस्तिष्क का कौन-सा भाग मुख्य रूप से संतुलन और गति के समन्वय को नियंत्रित करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Cerebellum
अनुमस्तिष्क (सेरिबेलम)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The cerebellum fine-tunes balance and the coordination of movement

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Hypothalamus
हाइपोथैलेमस: The hypothalamus controls temperature, hunger and hormones

B — Cerebrum
प्रमस्तिष्क: The cerebrum handles thought, memory and voluntary action

C — Medulla oblongata
मेडुला ऑब्लोंगेटा: The medulla controls vital reflexes such as breathing and heart rate

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Cerebellar damage causes unsteady gait and poor coordination, so watch for falls

question:
A patient with depression says that life is not worth living. The nurse should:

अवसाद वाला रोगी कहता है कि जीवन जीने लायक नहीं है। नर्स को क्या करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Take the statement seriously, assess the risk of self-harm and ensure safety
बात को गंभीरता से लें, स्वयं को हानि पहुँचाने का जोखिम आँकें और सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करें

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Any talk of life not being worth living demands a serious suicide-risk assessment and safety measures

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Ignore the statement as attention-seeking
इसे ध्यान खींचने की बात मानकर अनदेखा करें: Such statements are never merely attention-seeking

C — Leave the patient alone in the room
रोगी को अकेले कमरे में छोड़ दें: Leaving the patient alone increases risk

D — Tell the patient not to talk like this and move on
रोगी से ऐसा न बोलने को कहकर आगे बढ़ जाएँ: Dismissing the feeling breaks trust

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Remove harmful objects and stay with a high-risk patient until help arrives
option_1:
Ignore the statement as attention-seeking

option_3:

रोगी को अकेले कमरे में छोड़ दें

रोगी से ऐसा न बोलने को कहकर आगे बढ़ जाएँ

question:
Before electroconvulsive therapy, the nurse should mainly ensure that the patient has:

विद्युत-आक्षेप चिकित्सा से पहले नर्स को मुख्य रूप से क्या सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Fasted and given informed consent
उपवास किया हो और सूचित सहमति दी हो

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Fasting prevents aspiration and consent is legally and ethically required before ECT

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — No intravenous access
कोई अंतःशिरा मार्ग न हो: Intravenous access is often needed for anaesthesia

B — Taken no medicine ever
कभी कोई दवा न ली हो: Regular medicines are managed, not stopped blindly

D — Eaten a heavy meal
भारी भोजन किया हो: A full stomach risks vomiting and aspiration during the procedure

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Record the baseline vitals and explain the procedure to reduce fear
option_1:
No intravenous access
कोई अंतःशिरा मार्ग न हो
option_2:
Taken no medicine ever
कभी कोई दवा न ली हो
option_3:
Fasted and given informed consent
उपवास किया हो और सूचित सहमति दी हो
option_4:
Eaten a heavy meal
भारी भोजन किया हो

question:
A firmly held false belief that cannot be corrected by reason is called a:

एक दृढ़ रूप से पकड़ी गई झूठी धारणा जिसे तर्क से नहीं सुधारा जा सकता, क्या कहलाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Delusion
भ्रम (डिल्यूज़न)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A delusion is a fixed false belief held despite clear evidence against it

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Illusion
भ्रांति (इल्यूज़न): An illusion is a misreading of a real stimulus

C — Obsession
जुनून: An obsession is an unwanted repeated thought

D — Hallucination
मतिभ्रम (हैलुसिनेशन): A hallucination is a false perception without a real stimulus

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Do not argue with a delusion; acknowledge the feeling and gently orient the patient to reality

question:
Which of the following is the best example of therapeutic communication?

निम्न में से कौन-सा चिकित्सकीय संवाद का सर्वोत्तम उदाहरण है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Using open-ended questions and listening actively
खुले प्रश्न पूछना और सक्रिय रूप से सुनना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Open-ended questions with active listening let the patient express feelings safely

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Giving false reassurance
झूठी तसल्ली देना: False reassurance blocks real feelings

C — Making a judgement about the patient
रोगी के बारे में निर्णय देना: Judgement stops the patient from opening up

D — Changing the subject when the patient is upset
रोगी के परेशान होने पर विषय बदल देना: Changing the subject shows that the nurse is not listening

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Use silence and simple reflecting statements to help the patient share concerns
option_2:
Using open-ended questions and listening actively
खुले प्रश्न पूछना और सक्रिय रूप से सुनना
option_3:
Making a judgement about the patient
रोगी के बारे में निर्णय देना
option_4:
Changing the subject when the patient is upset
रोगी के परेशान होने पर विषय बदल देना

question:
An autoclave sterilises articles mainly by using:

ऑटोक्लेव मुख्य रूप से किसके द्वारा वस्तुओं को विसंक्रमित करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Steam under pressure
दबाव में भाप

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Moist heat as steam under pressure kills even spores, so it is the most reliable method

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Chemical solution only
केवल रासायनिक घोल: Chemicals suit only heat-sensitive items

B — Ultraviolet light
पराबैंगनी प्रकाश: Ultraviolet light disinfects surfaces, not instruments

D — Dry heat only
केवल शुष्क ऊष्मा: Dry heat needs much longer and is less effective

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate sterilisation from disinfection, and bacteria from viruses - they are common distractors.

💎 PNC Pearl: Follow the correct time, temperature and pressure for full sterilisation

question:
Malaria is caused by a:

मलेरिया किसके कारण होता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Protozoan parasite
प्रोटोज़ोआ परजीवी

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Malaria is caused by the protozoan Plasmodium

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Fungus
कवक: Fungi cause diseases such as ringworm

C — Bacterium
जीवाणु: Bacteria cause diseases such as tuberculosis

D — Virus
विषाणु: Viruses cause diseases such as measles

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate sterilisation from disinfection, and bacteria from viruses - they are common distractors.

💎 PNC Pearl: The Anopheles mosquito transmits the malaria parasite, so vector control is essential

question:
The classical signs of acute inflammation are:

तीव्र शोथ के पारंपरिक लक्षण कौन-से हैं:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Redness, heat, swelling and pain
लालिमा, ऊष्मा, सूजन और दर्द

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Redness, heat, swelling and pain are the classical signs of inflammation

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Blue discolouration only
केवल नीलापन: Blue discolouration suggests poor oxygen supply

B — Pallor, coldness and numbness
पीलापन, ठंडक और सुन्नपन: Pallor and coldness suggest reduced blood flow, not inflammation

C — Only fever
केवल बुखार: Fever may occur but is not the only sign

⚠️ Exam Trap: Distinguish acute from chronic, and reversible from irreversible, before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Watch inflamed wounds for spreading redness and pus, which may signal infection
option_2:
Pallor, coldness and numbness
पीलापन, ठंडक और सुन्नपन
option_4:
Redness, heat, swelling and pain
लालिमा, ऊष्मा, सूजन और दर्द

question:
Iron-deficiency anaemia on a peripheral blood film typically shows red cells that are:

परिधीय रक्त फिल्म में लौह-न्यूनता रक्ताल्पता सामान्यतः कैसी लाल रक्त कोशिकाएँ दिखाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Microcytic and hypochromic
लघुकोशिकीय और अल्पवर्णीय

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Iron deficiency makes red cells smaller and paler than normal

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Normal in size and colour
आकार और रंग में सामान्य: The cells are not normal in iron deficiency

B — Macrocytic and hyperchromic
दीर्घकोशिकीय और अति-वर्णीय: Large, dark cells occur in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency

C — Sickle-shaped only
केवल हँसिया-आकार: Sickle cells are seen in sickle-cell disease

⚠️ Exam Trap: Distinguish acute from chronic, and reversible from irreversible, before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The low mean corpuscular volume and low haemoglobin together support the diagnosis
option_1:
Normal in size and colour
आकार और रंग में सामान्य

question:
Bleeding gums and poor wound healing suggest a deficiency of:

मसूड़ों से खून आना और घाव का धीमा भरना किसकी कमी की ओर संकेत करता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Vitamin C
विटामिन C

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vitamin C is needed for collagen, so its lack causes bleeding gums and poor healing

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Vitamin A
विटामिन A: Vitamin A deficiency affects vision and skin

C — Vitamin D
विटामिन D: Vitamin D deficiency affects bones

D — Vitamin K
विटामिन K: Vitamin K deficiency causes easy bruising and bleeding, but not this picture

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate the deficiency disease from its dietary source - exams mix the two.

💎 PNC Pearl: Advise citrus fruits, guava and green leafy vegetables to prevent the deficiency

question:
A patient with liver disease is usually advised a diet that is:

यकृत रोग वाले रोगी को सामान्यतः कैसा आहार सलाह दिया जाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. High in carbohydrate with adequate protein and low fat
कार्बोहाइड्रेट से भरपूर, पर्याप्त प्रोटीन और कम वसा युक्त

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A liver-friendly diet gives energy from carbohydrate and adequate protein while sparing the liver from extra fat

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only fluids
केवल तरल: Fluids alone cannot meet energy and protein needs

B — Very high in fat
अत्यधिक वसा युक्त: A very high fat load is hard on the liver

D — Very low in all nutrients
सभी पोषक तत्वों में अत्यंत कम: Severe restriction causes malnutrition and slows recovery

⚠️ Exam Trap: Separate the deficiency disease from its dietary source - exams mix the two.

💎 PNC Pearl: Small, frequent meals help a patient with liver disease eat enough
option_3:
High in carbohydrate with adequate protein and low fat
कार्बोहाइड्रेट से भरपूर, पर्याप्त प्रोटीन और कम वसा युक्त
option_4:
Very low in all nutrients
सभी पोषक तत्वों में अत्यंत कम

question:
While preparing the duty roster, the nurse manager should mainly ensure that:

ड्यूटी रोस्टर बनाते समय नर्सिंग प्रबंधक को मुख्य रूप से क्या सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Each shift has the right number and skill mix of staff
प्रत्येक पाली में सही संख्या और कौशल-मिश्रण वाले स्टाफ हों

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Safe patient care needs the right number of staff with the right skills on every shift

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Only senior staff are listed
केवल वरिष्ठ स्टाफ सूची में रखें: Experience must be balanced with junior staff for supervision

B — Everyone always gets the preferred shift
सभी को हमेशा पसंद की पाली मिले: Personal preference cannot override patient needs

C — Overtime is avoided at any cost
हर हाल में ओवरटाइम से बचें: Occasional overtime may be needed to keep staffing safe

⚠️ Exam Trap: Remember that delegation transfers the task but never the accountability.

💎 PNC Pearl: Consider patient acuity, not just head-count, when making the roster

Only senior staff are listed
केवल वरिष्ठ स्टाफ सूची में रखें

Everyone always gets the preferred shift

question:
An adverse event involving a patient must be:

रोगी से जुड़ी कोई प्रतिकूल घटना कैसे होनी चाहिए:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. Documented factually and reported as per policy
तथ्यात्मक रूप से दर्ज की जाए और नीति के अनुसार रिपोर्ट की जाए

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Honest, factual reporting helps find the cause and prevent harm to others

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Discussed only informally
केवल अनौपचारिक रूप से चर्चा की जाए: Informal talk leaves no record for learning

C — Hidden to protect the unit's reputation
यूनिट की छवि बचाने के लिए छिपाई जाए: Hiding events endangers future patients

D — Deleted after some time
कुछ समय बाद हटा दी जाए: Records must be kept, not deleted

⚠️ Exam Trap: Remember that delegation transfers the task but never the accountability.

💎 PNC Pearl: An incident report is for safety, not for punishment of the staff
option_1:
Discussed only informally
केवल अनौपचारिक रूप से चर्चा की जाए
option_2:
Documented factually and reported as per policy
तथ्यात्मक रूप से दर्ज की जाए और नीति के अनुसार रिपोर्ट की जाए
option_3:

option_4:

कुछ समय बाद हटा दी जाए

question:
The middle value of a data set arranged in order of size is called the:

आकार के क्रम में लगाए गए आँकड़ों का बीच का मान क्या कहलाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Median
माध्यिका

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The median is the middle value in an ordered set

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Mean
माध्य: The mean is the arithmetic average

C — Mode
बहुलक: The mode is the most frequent value

D — Range
परास: The range is the spread between the highest and lowest values

⚠️ Exam Trap: In research questions define the term precisely - reliability, validity and sampling are often interchanged.

💎 PNC Pearl: The median is more useful than the mean when extreme values distort the data

question:
A hypothesis that states there is no difference between the groups being compared is called a:

ऐसी परिकल्पना जो कहती है कि तुलना किए जा रहे समूहों के बीच कोई अंतर नहीं है, क्या कहलाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Null hypothesis
शून्य परिकल्पना

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The null hypothesis assumes no real difference until the data show otherwise

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Dependent variable
आश्रित चर: A variable is what is measured, not the hypothesis

B — Alternative hypothesis
वैकल्पिक परिकल्पना: The alternative hypothesis claims a difference exists

C — Research question
शोध प्रश्न: A research question gives direction, not a statement of no difference

⚠️ Exam Trap: In research questions define the term precisely - reliability, validity and sampling are often interchanged.

💎 PNC Pearl: Statistical tests decide whether the data allow the null hypothesis to be rejected

question:
The enzyme that breaks down hydrogen peroxide is:

हाइड्रोजन पेरोक्साइड को तोड़ने वाला एंजाइम कौन-सा है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Catalase
कैटालेज़

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Catalase splits hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Pepsin
पेप्सिन: Pepsin digests protein in the stomach

B — Amylase
एमाइलेज़: Amylase digests starch

C — Lipase
लाइपेज़: Lipase digests fats

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Hydrogen peroxide foams on a wound because of the catalase in the tissues

question:
According to Maslow, which need comes just after physiological needs?

मास्लो के अनुसार शारीरिक आवश्यकताओं के ठीक बाद कौन-सी आवश्यकता आती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Safety and security
सुरक्षा और संरक्षा

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Safety comes right after the basic physiological needs in Maslow's order

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Self-actualisation
आत्म-सिद्धि: Self-actualisation is the highest need

C — Esteem
सम्मान: Esteem comes after safety and belonging

D — Belonging and love
अपनापन और प्रेम: Belonging and love come after safety

⚠️ Exam Trap: In mental health questions, choose the response that is non-judgemental and preserves safety first.

💎 PNC Pearl: Meet the lower needs first, because a frightened or unsafe patient cannot attend to higher needs

question:
The process by which a person learns the culture, values and norms of society is called:

वह प्रक्रिया जिससे व्यक्ति समाज की संस्कृति, मूल्य और मानदंड सीखता है, क्या कहलाती है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. Socialisation
समाजीकरण

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Socialisation is the lifelong process of learning society's culture and norms

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Migration
प्रवासन: Migration is the movement of people

B — Urbanisation
शहरीकरण: Urbanisation is the growth of towns

D — Stratification
स्तरीकरण: Stratification is the division of society into layers

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Pearl: Family and school are the first agents of socialisation, shaping health habits early

question:
A genetic disorder that appears only when both alleles of a gene are abnormal is called:

ऐसा आनुवंशिक विकार जो तब ही प्रकट होता है जब किसी जीन के दोनों युग्मविकल्पी असामान्य हों, क्या कहलाता है:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. Autosomal recessive
अप्रभावी (रिसेसिव)

🧠 Clinical Rationale: A recessive disorder needs both alleles to be faulty before it shows

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — Autosomal dominant
प्रभावी (डॉमिनेंट): A dominant disorder shows even with one faulty allele

C — X-linked dominant
X-संबद्ध प्रभावी: X-linked dominant also shows with a single faulty allele

D — Chromosomal only
केवल गुणसूत्रीय: Chromosomal disorders are not defined this way

⚠️ Exam Trap: For genetic questions work out the pattern of inheritance before the probability.

💎 PNC Pearl: Recessive disorders are more common with marriage between close relatives, so genetic counselling matters

question:
Before an invasive procedure the nurse's main role in informed consent is to:

किसी आक्रामक प्रक्रिया से पहले सूचित सहमति में नर्स की मुख्य भूमिका क्या है:
